basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 5 years of experience building full-stack features, integrations, and data pipelines for enterprise platforms. Experienced translating business needs into reliable technical solutions and collaborating across teams; now pursuing client-facing engineering, implementation, and technical product roles.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on enterprise financial platforms, leading feature delivery and cross-functional collaboration across international teams.
highlights: Led the end-to-end lifecycle of large-scale features for global partners, overseeing design, test driven development (JUnit, Jest), deployment, and ongoing support across cross-functional teams.

Established functional requirements by collaborating across departments on API specifications, stored procedure interfaces, business logic, and expected outcomes to ensure solutions aligned with organizational needs.
Streamlined data operations by consolidating disparate historical storage into Snowflake on Azure, optimizing storage costs while ensuring high availability for cross-functional teams.
Drove Agile methodology adoption through story creation, sprint refinement, and iterative delivery for international integrations.
Produced technical documentation including system specifications, process flowcharts, and maintenance guides to support knowledge transfer and long-term maintainability.
Improved operational stability by conducting system analysis and engineering automated health-check tooling and validation scripts to proactively detect and remediate deployment regressions.

Optimized application performance through advanced Oracle SQL schema design, stored procedure development, JPA/Hibernate ORM for efficient entity mapping and query optimization, and high-throughput multi-threaded Apache Kafka pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions.
Developed full-stack features using TypeScript, React, and Redux on the frontend and Spring Boot with Java 21 on the backend, integrating with internal enterprise systems.
Mentored and supported junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and documented troubleshooting strategies to elevate team capability.
Evaluated and applied emerging technologies and frameworks to continuously improve software quality and development processes.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Built security tooling for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Built a React/Redux security dashboard focused on automated vulnerability detection and remediation within source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
Resolved critical logic flaws in security risk-scoring algorithms, ensuring data accuracy and reducing false-positive alerts for enterprise clients.
Implemented automated testing suites using Jest and Cypress, ensuring high feature reliability and UI performance across staging and production environments.
Ensured accessibility (a11y) compliance across the web application, implementing keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes to support screen-reader users and diverse accessibility needs.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Developed full-stack automation solutions to streamline enterprise business processes.
highlights: Orchestrated full-stack automation solutions using C#/.NET and SQL to streamline enterprise workflows across OCR, HR, and fundraising departments.

projects.name: Meal Planner
projects.description: Full-stack household meal-planning application for managing recipes, weekly plans, leftovers, and shared grocery lists
highlights: Built a multi-user meal-planning workflow with SvelteKit, TypeScript, Convex, and Tailwind CSS, including authentication, household invitations, shared planning, and real-time data synchronization.
Designed domain logic for meal scheduling, skipped slots, leftovers, and automatically grouped shopping lists to turn weekly plans into an actionable grocery workflow.
Used AI-assisted development as a force multiplier for prototyping, implementation, debugging, and iteration while retaining ownership of architecture, validation, and code quality.
